checks.text: The page shows the heading "Nonogram Puzzle" and, on first load with no seed entered, displays the text "Enter a seed to start".
Typing "1" in the field labelled "Seed" and clicking the button "New puzzle" loads a 5x5 grid; the row clue for row 1 shows "3" and the column clue for column 1 shows "3".
After loading seed "1", clicking the cell at row 1, column 1 toggles it to filled; the cell displays the text "X" and the score display shows "Score: 1".
After loading seed "1" and filling the cell at row 1, column 1, clicking the cell at row 1, column 2 toggles it to filled; the cell displays "X" and the score display shows "Score: 2".
After loading seed "1" and filling the cell at row 1, column 1, clicking the cell at row 1, column 1 again toggles it to empty; the cell displays "-" and the score display shows "Score: 0".
After loading seed "1" and filling only the cell at row 1, column 1, clicking the button "Check" shows the toast text "Not solved: 1 of 13 filled cells are right and 12 are missing".
After loading seed "1", clicking exactly the 13 cells of the solution (see the notes), clicking the button "Check" shows the toast text "Solved!" and "Best: 13".
Clicking the tab labelled "History" shows a list of past puzzles; after solving seed "1", the list contains an item with the text "Seed 1 - Solved".

Reload keeps the current puzzle state: after loading seed "1" and filling the cell at row 1, column 1, reloading the page still shows the cell at row 1, column 1 displaying "X" and the score display showing "Score: 1".
